CustomField.description: The date the customer placed the order. This is the "Order Date" the archival batch ages against: Delivered orders whose Order Date is more than one year old are moved into abc_Order_Archive__b. Deliberately distinct from the standard EffectiveDate, which is the date the order takes commercial effect.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date the customer placed this order. Drives the one-year archival rule.
CustomField.label: Order Date
